sloka: सुराणामसुराणां वा नागगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् ।यक्षाणां किन्नराणां वा का त्वं भवसि शोभने ।। ५.३३.५।।।।
transliteration: surāṇāmasurāṇāṁ vā nāgagandharvarakṣasām ।yakṣāṇāṁ kinnarāṇāṁ vā kā tvaṁ bhavasi śobhane ।। 5.33.5।।।।

translations.english: "O noble lady, are you a goddess or a demoness, a naga, a gandharva, a rakshasa, a yaksha or a kinnera?
